items.headline: DogeOS 'Very Close' to Launching $DOGE DeFi Layer
items.summary: DogeOS says its DeFi features and app layer for $DOGE are imminent, potentially bringing smart-contract utility to Dogecoin for the first time.

items.headline: $VVS Dominates Cronos as DEX Volume Jumps 26%
items.summary: $VVS Finance now accounts for three-quarters of Cronos TVL while DEX volume climbs 26%, signaling renewed momentum for the chain's top DEX.

items.headline: $SUSHI Acquired by Katana in DeFi Consolidation Play
items.summary: Katana's acquisition of Sushi brings spot trading and yield in-house, a major shake-up for the veteran $SUSHI DEX ecosystem.

items.headline: Plume Bets on Distribution as $PLUME Vaults Hit $250M
items.summary: Plume CEO Chris Yin is prioritizing distribution over pure tokenization as the RWA network's vaults reach $250M, boosting the $PLUME ecosystem.

items.headline: Nvidia Perps Plunge 10% on $HYPE Amid Huang Drama
items.summary: Nvidia perpetuals on Hyperliquid dropped 10% after reports its board may oust Jensen Huang, showcasing $HYPE's growing equity-perp markets.
